question: 闸门 approve 返回 False 时，一次完整 run 里回填给模型、含「declined」字样的工具结果有几条？
verify:
import json
from agent_loop import Agent, Tool, FakeModelClient

tools = [
    Tool("lookup", "Read-only lookup.", {"type": "object", "properties": {"q": {"type": "string"}}},
         lambda a: json.dumps({"temp": 22})),
    Tool("publish", "Writes externally.", {"type": "object", "properties": {"to": {"type": "string"}}},
         lambda a: json.dumps({"sent": True}), writes=True),
]

agent = Agent(system="s", tools=tools, client=FakeModelClient("lookup", "publish"),
              approve=lambda tool, args: False)
res = agent.run("查一下温度并发布。")
result = sum(1 for m in res.messages
             for b in (m["content"] if isinstance(m["content"], list) else [])
             if isinstance(b, dict) and "declined" in str(b.get("content", "")))

question: 离线自检（read → write 被闸门拒 → 作答被 verifier 拦一次）总共跑了几轮？
verify:
import json
from agent_loop import Agent, Tool, FakeModelClient

tools = [
    Tool("lookup", "Read-only lookup.", {"type": "object", "properties": {"q": {"type": "string"}}},
         lambda a: json.dumps({"temp": 22})),
    Tool("publish", "Writes externally.", {"type": "object", "properties": {"to": {"type": "string"}}},
         lambda a: json.dumps({"sent": True}), writes=True),
]

state = {"n": 0}

def verify(text, messages):
    state["n"] += 1
    return "请确认这是给用户的最终答复。" if state["n"] == 1 else None

agent = Agent(system="你是助手。", tools=tools, client=FakeModelClient("lookup", "publish"),
              approve=lambda tool, args: False, verify=verify)
result = agent.run("查一下温度并发布。").turns
